newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motor in China car joint venture.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motor in China car joint venture.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Monday it had received permission from the Hunan provincial government to form a joint venture to produce its Pajero sport-utility vehicle.

The joint venture, formed at the end of December and capitalised at 1.3 billion yen, is owned more than 50 percent by China Changfeng Auto Factory, 19.72 percent by Mitsubishi Motors and the rest by local investors, a Mitsubishi spokesman said.
The joint venture hopes to produce 3,700 Pajeros in 1997, and 8,000 in 1998, the spokesman said.
China Changfeng has assembled 500 Pajeros in 1996 with Mitsubishi's technical assistance, the spokesman said without elaborating.
